Hello! My name is Du Du and I come from China. I just finished my undergraduate study at UBC as well and I’m now at MDS program at UBC! I would like to explore the world using the latest technology under the emerge of LLM. Hopefully I can get into the field of Data Science!

title: My first weeks in MDS
text:
The orientation was great! I made several friends and chatted a lot. The professors and coordinators were kind and warm.
Week of MDS has finished! Initially I felt nervous and afraid of can’t catching up. However, things went smoother and I managed to submit all homework before Saturday!
When I write this post, I get busier than the past week. I have so much thigns to do!!!



Orientation day on campus.

title: About
text:
Background
Born and raised in Tianjin, China, yes, like the stereotypes I can do crosstalks for sure. I studied until second year of my undergrads and transferred to UBC Sauder and finished my undergraduate this May. Then I directly enterred into MDS at UBC for further study.

title: About
text:
Why Data Science
While studying in NWAFU (Northwest Agricultural and Forestry University) in Shaanxi, China, I did Computer Science and find that it is really exciting to explore how the computers work. Further, with the merge of AI tools I have also gain a variety of knowledges outside of classroom and learned health related tips in my daily life. I would like to dive into the field of data science to keep in pace of the development of the world. That’s probablity why I chose DS.
